data.name: Store Owner Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Step into the world of retail and build the store exactly the way you want. Order products, set prices, serve customers, and grow your business step by step. Play at your own pace or invite your friends and work together to create a thriving store.

〖Your Store, Your Rules〗

You start with a small store, but it is entirely up to you what it will become in the future.

Place shelves, refrigerators, and freezers, organize aisles, and make use of the available space however you see fit. Create a convenient layout for your customers or design the store in your own unique style.

Every decision affects how your store operates.

〖Order Products and Manage Your Stock〗

A store cannot thrive with empty shelves.

Use your tablet to browse the available products and order the goods you need. Receive deliveries, move products into storage, and regularly restock the shelves.

Keep an eye on your inventory and make sure your customers can always find what they are looking for.

〖Step Behind the Register〗

Once your customers are done shopping, it is time to serve them.

Scan products, accept card and cash payments, and give the correct change. Efficient service will help you avoid long queues and keep your customers satisfied.

Sometimes running a store means planning major investments, and sometimes it simply means quickly scanning the next product.

〖Buy Low, Sell for Profit〗

Product prices can change, so keeping an eye on the market can make a big difference.

Choose the right moment to purchase goods, set your own selling prices, and manage your profit margins. Prices that are too high may discourage customers, while prices that are too low can reduce your profits.

Find the right balance and increase your store's earnings.

〖Grow Your Business〗

Every satisfied customer brings you one step closer to the next stage of development.

Invest your earnings into expanding your store, purchasing new equipment, and increasing your product selection. Over time, a small shop can grow into a much larger and more profitable business.

Expand at your own pace and watch your store evolve with every decision you make.

〖Run the Store Together with Friends〗

You do not have to handle everything on your own.

Invite up to 3 other players and run the store together in online co-op. Divide the responsibilities — one player can work at the register, another can restock the shelves, while someone else receives deliveries and manages the storage area.

Good organization and teamwork will help keep the store running smoothly.

〖Main Features〗

  • Relaxing first-person store management simulation

  • Freely arrange shelves, refrigerators, freezers, and other equipment

  • Order products using a tablet

  • Receive deliveries, store goods, and restock shelves

  • Serve customers at the checkout

  • Accept cash and card payments

  • Dynamically changing product prices

  • Set your own selling prices and manage profit margins

  • Expand your store and invest in business growth

  • Online co-op for up to 4 players

  • Divide responsibilities between players

  • Relaxing gameplay focused on management, organization, and growing your own store

data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Turkish, Hungarian, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 6GB / RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5-10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400F / Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060 / RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5-10 GB available space
